# Knovera Vector RAG API Documentation

## Overview
The Knovera API enables seamless integration between internal document repositories and downstream Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models.

### Authentication
All requests require a valid Bearer Token in the authorization header:
`Authorization: Bearer <KNOVERA_API_KEY>`

### Endpoints

#### 1. POST `/v1/retrieve`
Queries the vector database for top-$K$ matching chunk contexts.

**Request Payload:**
```json
{
  "query": "What is our customer refund policy?",
  "top_k": 5,
  "similarity_threshold": 0.75
}
```

**Response Payload:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "matches": [
    {
      "source": "customer_policy.txt",
      "score": 0.92,
      "text": "Customers are eligible for a 100% full refund within a 30-day window..."
    }
  ]
}
```

#### 2. POST `/v1/chat/completions`
Generates grounded responses utilizing system prompt constraints and retrieved document context.

KNOVERA CUSTOMER SERVICE & REFUND POLICY
Document ID: POL-2026-089
Effective Date: January 15, 2026

1. Overview
Knovera is committed to delivering high-quality enterprise support and RAG solutions. This policy outlines our standard customer service response times, eligible refund windows, and escalation procedures.

2. Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Tier 1 Technical Support: Initial response within 2 business hours.
- Tier 2 Specialized Engineering: Initial response within 6 business hours.
- Emergency Outage Response: 24/7 dedicated response within 15 minutes.

3. Customer Refund & Cancellation Criteria
- Customers are eligible for a 100% full refund within a 30-day window from the initial subscription activation date.
- Refund requests submitted after 30 days but before 60 days are subject to a pro-rated service fee calculation.
- No refunds will be issued for billing cycles beyond 60 days, though accounts can be paused or cancelled at any time without additional penalty.

KNOVERA VECTOR SEARCH ARCHITECTURE & CLEANING GUIDELINES
Document ID: DOC-2026-ARC-01
Published: August 2026

1. System Architecture Overview
The Knovera RAG platform integrates multi-format document intake with state-of-the-art vector
retrieval. When documents are ingested, high-quality text cleaning is crucial for downstream semantic search performance. Without robust cleaning, vector models embed redundant noise rather than genuine domain facts.

We've observed that "raw extracted text" contains serious encoding artifacts, including mojibake — such
as broken smart quotes and dashes — which degrade embedding cosine similarity scores.

2. Scalable Ingestion Pipeline
Our intake engine processes documents in parallel across distributed worker nodes. Each worker normalizes line endings, strips page boilerplate, and performs
unicode NFKC canonical transformation.

Key Engineering Rules:
  • Preserve code snippets and numeric figures intact.
  • Never remove punctuation aggressively.
  • Maintain section headers to assist semantic chunk boundary detection.

3. Retrieval Quality Benchmarks
During internal evaluations, queries executed against cleaned corpora achieved a 94.8% precision@5
compared to only 68.2% on uncleaned corpora. Cleaning eliminates false positive token overlaps
caused by repeated page headers like "KNOVERA CONFIDENTIAL" appearing across every single chunk.
